app.name: Strompreis EPEX
app.summary: The electricity price now, with a graph of today and tomorrow, from an EPEX Spot sensor.
app.tile_example: The price now and the day's graph
app.unit_hint: Show the price in euros per kWh (0.273) or in cents per kWh (27.3).
app.decimals_hint: How many decimals the price shows. In cents one is enough.
app.feed_in_hint: A formula in p for what a kWh you feed back brings, such as p-0.02, or a fixed price such as 0.07. Each bar then runs from the feed-in price to the delivery price. Empty: no feed-in price.
app.delivery_hint: A formula in p, the sensor's price per kWh in its own currency (also when you show cents): (p+0.12)*1.19 adds a surcharge, then 19% VAT. A number alone is a fixed price. Empty: the sensor's price.
app.graph_hint: Bars, or a stepped line that follows the price slot by slot. The card shows the graph of the tile you open it from.
app.fill_hint: With a stepped line: a faint fill under it, down to zero or to the feed-in price.
app.grid_hint: Lines across the graph at the price labels it shows.
app.start_hint: 0: today and tomorrow from midnight. An hour such as 13 shows exactly 24 hours, from 13:00 to 13:00 the next day; before 13:00 from yesterday 13:00 to today 13:00.
